name: Lead Qualification

brief_prefill.goal: Qualify inbound leads and capture their contact details so the team can follow up on the good ones.
brief_prefill.never_do: Never quote final pricing. Do not push if the caller is not interested.

steps: Greet the caller and name the business
Ask what they are looking for
Ask three to five qualifying questions from the brief: budget, timeline, location, decision-maker
Ask whether there is anything else the caller needs, and carry on if there is
Only once the caller says there is nothing else, thank them for calling and end the call

analysis_fields.name: callback_number
analysis_fields.description: The number to call back on.

analysis_fields.name: email
analysis_fields.description: The email address the caller gave.

analysis_fields.name: need
analysis_fields.description: What the caller is looking for.

analysis_fields.name: timeline
analysis_fields.description: When the caller wants to act.

analysis_fields.name: qualified
analysis_fields.description: True when the lead met the qualifying criteria.

rules: Do not push a caller who says they are not interested.

example_texts.real_estate: We are a residential real estate team covering the South Shore. Listings, buyer representation and free home evaluations.
example_texts.legal: We are a two-lawyer family law practice downtown. Divorce, custody and mediation. First consultation is thirty minutes and is paid.
example_texts.generic: Describe what your business does, who you serve, and what makes a call worth taking.
